title: oncall: add runbook quick-links + compact diagnostics helpers
author: Priya Ramachandran
description: Motivation: On-call flows frequently require fast access to runbooks and compact diagnostics; current incident-bot responses surface verbose diagnostics and users must copy links from multiple places. This PR adds a compact runbook quick-links section to oncall messages, a new --compact diagnostics mode that returns a one-line summary + top 3 runbooks, and helper utilities in slo-toolkit to rank runbook suggestions by recent hits. Changes are backwards-compatible and behind a feature flag ONCALL_RUNBOOK_QUICKLINKS. Summary of changes: 1) incident-bot: assemble and render a compact quick-links section in message payloads; 2) incident-bot: implement --compact diagnostic renderer and CLI flag; 3) slo-toolkit: add runbook-ranking util (recency+uptime heuristic) and tests; 4) telemetry: emit runbook_suggestion.{rank,source} metrics; 5) docs: update oncall playbook and runbook authoring guide. Testing: unit tests for ranking and renderer, integration smoke test that sends a simulated alert and asserts quick-links present; manual verification during staging oncall rotation. Rollout: feature-flagged deploy to staging, monitor runbook_suggestion metric and the oncall slack channel for feedback, then enable for 10% of incidents and gradually ramp. Linked Linear task ENG-2789 tracks rollout checklist.

Anika Sharma: The ranking heuristic seems reasonable but could be gamed by recent test runs; can we weight by production hits only?
Priya Ramachandran: Updated ranking util to filter by environment tag and added a unit test for production-only weighting.
Tomoko Ito: Telemetry looks good. Please ensure metrics have proper tag cardinality limits documented.
Priya Ramachandran: Added docs note and instrumentation comment with suggested tag whitelist.
release_notes: Adds runbook quick-links to oncall messages, a compact diagnostics mode for faster triage, and a runbook-ranking utility in slo-toolkit. Telemetry: runbook_suggestion.rank and runbook_suggestion.source emitted. Feature-flagged rollout.
